summary: Add namespace-owned agent-card queue and selected label dependencies

replay.detail: No startup replay, source backfill, or reader activation is added. The owner explicitly installs and drains its namespace.

schema.detail: Private opt-in namespaced queue, order, counters, cursors and indexes are created only by the composing installer. Default Store schema is unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No public protocol, pagination token, route or client capability change. Default readers retain their existing behavior.

downtime.detail: No service restart or additional interruption is introduced by this dependency helper.

manual.detail: No user action or default installation is required. Production qualification and activation remain with the shared source and agent-card owners.

recovery.detail: Default unopened components require no recovery. Explicitly installed private namespaces require bounded owner retirement/reclamation; dropping a binary does not remove their tables.
